name: Azuma Natsuhiko
source:
Natsuhiko possesses a cold way of thinking, and rarely raises his voice. For some reason, he is after the lives of the members with powers aboard the Norn. Good with mechanics, he's good at inventing things. He is also the ship's control specialist.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Mikoto as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=natsuhiko]official website profile[/URL]]
